biography.value: Summoning an Ancient Flame is a statement of intent. It enters using World Fire (2 actions) if enemies are grouped, then uses the third action to begin Primordial Strike on the highest-priority target. Subsequent turns spend two actions on Primordial Strike and a third on Solar Beam against anything trying to engage from distance — all three actions working, the third at penalty but still landing. The terrain around an Ancient Flame becomes inhospitable to anyone not under its protection within the first round and does not improve from there. It has existed long enough to understand what mortal commanders need from it and will follow complex instructions without misinterpretation — but it will communicate disagreement with wasteful tactics through the summoner's connection rather than simply complying with something it judges as poor strategy.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 30 ft, Tremorsense 120 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Primordial Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (8 + 7 Str) + 5 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 fire damage; Burning condition; no save.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 fire damage + Burning; all creatures within 10 feet of target take 12 fire damage.

Solar Beam [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 150 ft, 5-foot-wide line passing through all intervening creatures.

  • Margin 1:: 20 fire damage (17 + 3 Dex) + Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning.
  • Margin 3: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning + Blinded; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Primordial Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 15 feet take 11 fire damage (Half DR). This radius cannot be reduced through positioning. World Fire (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases its full elemental nature in a 60-foot diameter. All non-designated creatures make a Reflex [Hard] save.

  • Margin 1:: 40 fire damage + Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 40 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning.
  • Margin 3: 40 fire damage, DR halved (round up) only. World Fire will not be used if the summoner or designated allies are within the area unless the Ancient Flame has no current instructions.

Fire Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical fire damage while within 60 feet. Momentum Defense: While the Ancient Flame has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Ancient Flame fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
